chunks: "It is sufficient for you in the recitation, when you are with them, to recite like the speech of the النفس."
ai.seo_question: How much recitation is sufficient when praying with others in congregation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding recitation in congregational prayer. It indicates that when one is praying with them in congregation, a very low, inward-style recitation is sufficient.
